description: This file defines the implementation details for MetalTensorImplStorage class, which manages tensor storage with Metal textures on iOS/macOS. It includes class definitions, methods for data copying, and output formatting.

classes.name: MetalTensorImplStorage::Impl
classes.description: Inner class that handles actual storage details including tensor sizes, strides, number of elements, and Metal texture wrapper.

methods.name: MetalTensorImplStorage::MetalTensorImplStorage
methods.description: Constructs with sizes, computing default strides.

methods.name: MetalTensorImplStorage::set_data_from_host
methods.description: Copies data from host memory into texture.

methods.name: MetalTensorImplStorage::copy_data_to_host
methods.description: Copies data from texture to host memory.
